nodes.text: Warm yourself and move along when you're able. That's the posting.

choices.text: I broke one of the warcamps out there.
I felled one of the named terrors.

nodes.text: Quiet at the fire. Loud everywhere else. Warcamps on the rises, ruins that _wake after dusk_, stones out deep with names on them. We hold the lamplight. Past that, no promises.
That was *you*? Then the east road breathes for a season. The Watch pays in respect and not much else. You've got mine.
We heard the name went quiet. Camps grow back by spring. Named things take longer. Fire's yours tonight.
